card.name: Just before water in mixing directions
card.fires_on: Words like add, adding, a total of, or partway through diluent names, in reconstitution or mixing directions where water or a liquid is about to be named.

modes.label: Add / adding verbs
modes.description: The verb add or a nearby linking word right before the amount of water to be added.
modes.example: reconstitute by<< adding>> 5 mL of Sterile Water for

modes.label: Inside diluent names
modes.description: Partway through names of diluents such as Sodium Chloride Injection or the diluent chamber.
modes.example: Sterile Water for Injection, USP Bacteriostatic Water for Injection, USP 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection,<< US>>P 0.45% Sodium
